name: Comahuesuchus
sum: Comahuesuchus is a notosuchian crocodylomorph from the Late Cretaceous of Argentina, described by Bonaparte in 1991.
wsnote: No body-length estimate is given in the sources consulted.
holotype: MUCPv-202 (C. brachybuccalis), from the Santonian Bajo de la Carpa Formation.
material: The type species from the Bajo de la Carpa Formation and C. bonapartei (Kellner et al. 2023) from the Sierra Barrosa and Portezuelo formations.
biology: The sources consulted describe its classification only; it appears closer to Mariliasuchus than to other notosuchians, and they give no direct evidence of diet or habits.
author: Bonaparte 1991
